newsitem.title: EGYPT: Kafr el-Zayat says 1995/6 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Kafr el-Zayat says 1995/6 profits up.

text.p: Kafr el-Zayat Pesticides and Chemicals made net after-tax profits of 7.635 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, 48.5 percent up on 5.141 million in 1994/5, according to audited results available on Sunday. The years end on June 30.
Turnover rose to 85.335 million pounds, 17.3 percent up on 72.748 million in the previous year, and profits before tax were 10.215 million, 47.6 percent up on 6.923 million.
The state privatised 65 percent of the company's 1.2 million shares in August at 29.00 pounds each. The shares were trading on the Egyptian stock exchange at 47.20 pounds on Sunday.
